newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU, New Zealand to sign veterinary accord on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: EU, New Zealand to sign veterinary accord on Tuesday.

text.p: The European Union and New Zealand will on Tuesday sign an agreement on the mutual recognition of veterinary and plant health standards, an EU official said.

The agreement, which will be signed during a meeting of EU farm ministers, is the first in a series the European Commission is negotiating with major trading partners, including the United States, Canada, Australia and Argentina.
The agreement applies sanitary and phytosanitary measures agreed in the GATT Uruguay Round of world trade negotiations and is part of a drive to harmonise import measures in the single EU market.
